// RED fixture for `residency-pin` — the lint MUST reject this.
// A store opened as a GLOBAL pool with no pinned region: the data-leaves-its-region bug class
// (ADR-11). Every store/stream/index/cache must declare its Region; there is no global pool.
pub async fn open_global_pool(url: &str) -> Pool {
    PgPool::connect(url).await.unwrap()
}
